claim: Mathur et al. (2018) is the primary source of the 3.49% figure that Hua et al. (2022) cite in contrast to their own 36.7% figure for affiliate-marketing link prevalence in YouTube Howto & Style videos.
stance_target: provenance of the 36.7% vs 3.49% sampling-bias pair
scope_conditions: YouTube Howto & Style content category, 2017 data collection
quoted_support: Prevalence of affiliate marketing across YouTube's Science & Technology and Howto & Style categories stood at 3.61% and 3.49% respectively.

claim: The 3.49% figure measures the prevalence of affiliate-marketing URLs in video descriptions within one content category, not creator income or living-wage attainment.
stance_target: the contradiction graph's attribution of the 36.7%/3.49% split to a 'living wage' or income-earning quantity
quoted_support: We found at least one affiliate URL in a total of 0.67% or 3,472 videos on YouTube, and a total of 0.85% or 18,237 pins on Pinterest.

claim: The study used 'random prefix sampling' -- generating random video/pin IDs directly -- to build an unbiased, non-popularity-gated sample, in contrast to crawls that start from popular/trending seed channels.
stance_target: existence of a genuine popularity-gated vs. random-sample methodological contrast between Hua et al. 2022's YouNiverse dataset and Mathur et al. 2018's sample
scope_conditions: sampling methodology for YouTube/Pinterest content studies

claim: Amazon Associates was the most common affiliate program detected on both platforms, appearing in 7,308 YouTube URL resolutions and 7,368 Pinterest URL resolutions.
quoted_support: Across both YouTube and Pinterest, Amazon's Associate Program had the largest presence (YouTube = 7,308, Pinterest = 7,368), closely followed by AliExpress' Affiliate Program (YouTube = 2,167, Pinterest = 785).

claim: The authors compiled the most comprehensive publicly available list at the time of affiliate-marketing URL patterns: 57 unique patterns from 33 different companies.
stance_target: methodology for detecting affiliate marketing content
quoted_support: Through our analysis, we compiled a total of 57 unique affiliate URL patterns from 33 different affiliate marketing companies—the most comprehensive publicly available list of its kind.
